lifecycle.draftModeBanner: You are editing a draft. The published organization stays unchanged until you publish successfully (extra confirmation may be required).
lifecycle.publishedViewBanner: Read-only: you are viewing the live, published structure. To change types, rules, or make structural moves, start or switch to a draft (org.admin).
lifecycle.noModelYet: No structure model exists yet. Create the first draft, then add node types and rules before publishing.
lifecycle.publishedNoDraft: A published model is active. To change the org schema, create a new draft that copies the current published node types and relationship rules. You will not edit the live org until you publish the draft.
lifecycle.bootstrapDialogBody: This creates a new empty draft (versioned). You will add node types and relationship rules, then publish when ready. This path is only for the first model — when a published model already exists, use “New draft from published” instead.
lifecycle.forkDialogBody: This creates a new draft and copies organization levels, relationship rules, and the full tree from the published model. Live production stays unchanged until you publish and pass validation. You can describe this draft in the optional field below.
lifecycle.abandonDialogBody: The draft will be archived and discarded. The active/production organization tree is untouched. You can create another draft later.
lifecycle.prePublishDraftOnly: Pre-publish: only a draft exists. Add types and rules, then publish to go live.

issues.NO_ROOT_TYPE: This draft has no top-level organization type. Mark exactly one type as the root.
issues.MULTIPLE_ROOT_TYPES: This draft has {{rootCount}} top-level types. Keep only one type marked as the root.
issues.DUPLICATE_TYPE_CODE: The type code «{{typeCode}}» is used more than once. Each type needs a unique code.
issues.UNREACHABLE_TYPE: The level «{{typeCode}}» is not connected to the top of your organization. Add a relationship rule so it can sit under the root or another allowed level.
issues.RULE_GRAPH_CYCLE: Some relationship rules form a loop (A under B and B under A). Remove the circular link.
issues.NO_WORK_CAPABLE_TYPE: No organization level is set up to own work. Turn on work ownership for at least one level.
issues.NO_ASSET_CAPABLE_TYPE: No organization level is set up to host assets. Turn on asset hosting for at least one level.
issues.MISSING_TYPE_CODE: «{{nodeName}}» uses the level «{{typeCode}}», which is not defined in this draft. Assign a valid level or add that type.
issues.PARENT_CHILD_NOT_ALLOWED: «{{nodeName}}» ({{childType}}) cannot sit under a {{parentType}} with the current relationship rules. Move it or update the rules.
issues.PARENT_CHILD_DRIFT: A parent–child relationship used in the tree is no longer allowed by the rules. Move the unit or restore the rule.
issues.COST_CENTER_INCOMPATIBLE: «{{nodeName}}» has a cost center, but its level «{{typeCode}}» does not allow cost centers. Remove the cost center or allow them on that level.
issues.UNMAPPED_ACTIVE_NODE_WITH_OPS_REFS: «{{nodeName}}» is still used by live data but is missing from this draft. Repair the draft copies, or detach those links before publishing.
